title: Covered Path
statementMd:
The on-board computer on Polycarp's car measured that the car speed at the beginning of some section of the path equals $*v*_{1}$ meters per second, and in the end it is $*v*_{2}$ meters per second. We know that this section of the route took exactly $*t*$ seconds to pass.

Assuming that at each of the seconds the speed is constant, and between seconds the speed can change at most by $*d*$ meters per second in absolute value (i.e., the difference in the speed of any two adjacent seconds does not exceed $*d*$ in absolute value), find the maximum possible length of the path section in meters.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*v*_{1}$ and $*v*_{2}$ ($1 ≤ *v*_{1}, *v*_{2} ≤ 100$) — the speeds in meters per second at the beginning of the segment and at the end of the segment, respectively.

The second line contains two integers $*t*$ ($2 ≤ *t* ≤ 100$) — the time when the car moves along the segment in seconds, $*d*$ **$(0 ≤ *d* ≤ 10)$** — the maximum value of the speed change between adjacent seconds.

It is guaranteed that there is a way to complete the segment so that:

- the speed in the first second equals $*v*_{1}$,
- the speed in the last second equals $*v*_{2}$,
- the absolute value of difference of speeds between any two adjacent seconds doesn't exceed $*d*$.

## Output

Print the maximum possible length of the path segment in meters.

## Note

In the first sample the sequence of speeds of Polycarpus' car can look as follows: 5, 7, 8, 6. Thus, the total path is $5 + 7 + 8 + 6 = 26$ meters.

In the second sample, as $*d* = 0$, the car covers the whole segment at constant speed $*v* = 10$. In $*t* = 10$ seconds it covers the distance of 100 meters.
statementZhMd:
Polycarp 的汽车上的车载计算机测得，在路径的某一段开始时，汽车速度为 $*v*_{1}$ 米/秒，结束时速度为 $*v*_{2}$ 米/秒。已知通过这一路段恰好花费了 $*t*$ 秒。

假设每一秒内速度保持不变，并且相邻两秒之间的速度变化量的绝对值最多为 $*d*$ 米/秒（即，任意相邻两秒的速度之差的绝对值不超过 $*d*$），求该路段可能达到的最大长度（单位：米）。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*v*_{1}$ 和 $*v*_{2}$（$1 ≤ *v*_{1}, *v*_{2} ≤ 100$），分别表示路段开始时和结束时的速度，单位为米/秒。

第二行包含两个整数 $*t*$（$2 ≤ *t* ≤ 100$）——汽车沿该路段行驶的时间（单位：秒），以及 $*d*$ **$(0 ≤ *d* ≤ 10)$**——相邻两秒之间速度变化的最大值。

保证存在一种完成该路段的方式，使得：

- 第一秒的速度等于 $*v*_{1}$；
- 最后一秒的速度等于 $*v*_{2}$；
- 任意相邻两秒之间速度差的绝对值不超过 $*d*$。

## 输出格式

输出该路段可能达到的最大长度，单位为米。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Polycarp 的汽车速度序列可以如下：5、7、8、6。因此，总路程为 $5 + 7 + 8 + 6 = 26$ 米。

在第二个样例中，由于 $*d* = 0$，汽车以恒定速度 $*v* = 10$ 行驶整个路段。在 $*t* = 10$ 秒内，它行驶了 100 米的距离。
